_about: Which sleeves trade. active: trades as designed. retired: no new entries, open positions run to their exits, and once flat its cash moves to the sleeve in sweep_to on that sleeve's next run. See nsebot/sleeves.py and docs/DIAGNOSIS.md.

swing.why: S4b dip reversion failed on untouched 2018-20 data and its full-engine backtest makes +2.9% a year, less than its idle cash would earn; the owner chose growth (docs/DIAGNOSIS.md)

intraday.why: no edge: 55 live trades net -0.30R each after costs, and no research variant was ever net-positive (docs/DIAGNOSIS.md section 2.2)
